name: modelV handoff score hoF + stock-strength SS
fit_note: No pickled fit existed; refit with identical code+data (sklearn LogisticRegression C=1.0 lbfgs max_iter=2000). max |p - cards_graded.pF| = 0.00e+00; manual sigmoid formula vs sklearn max diff 1.11e-16.

fit_data.cards: run-1305 HO (live-lane early-trigger) cards, 142 replay days, fit months date<2026-07-20
fit_data.label: win35: bid reaches >=1.4*ask(m+2) before <=0.65*ask, stop checked first, to close

standardize.formula: z_f=(x_f-mean_f)/(std_f+1e-9); std is pandas sample std (ddof=1)

handoff_model.per_expiry_split: none in the model (cdte is a feature, 0 or 1); per-expiry only in the v2-equivalent mapping

v2_equiv_mapping.note: a,b from fit-month logistic of hybrid win35 on v2_score per DTE. Inverse: p=1/(1+exp(-(a+b*v2eq))).

feature_definitions.bars: Alpaca 1-min RTH bars 09:30-15:59 ET (390 slots; missing minutes forward-filled with last close as flat bars). m = minute index from 09:30 (0..389) of the ALERT bar; all stock features use the CLOSE of bar m. Entry = ask at minute m+2. s=+1 calls, -1 puts; X=s*close, O=s*open of bar 0.
feature_definitions.mo_atr: (s*close[m]-s*open[0])/ATR14; ATR14 = mean of last 14 daily RTH true ranges max(H-L,|H-prevC|,|L-prevC|), excluding today
feature_definitions.rvol: cumvol[m]/base[m]; base = elementwise mean of the cumulative-volume curves of the last up-to-10 prior full days (>=380 bars), needs >=5 such days else NaN
feature_definitions.pm_brk: 1 if s*close[m] > PMH (calls) / -close>-PML (puts); PM = 04:00-09:29 ET 1-min high/low; 0 if no PM bars
feature_definitions.pd_brk: 1 if s*close[m] > prior-day RTH high (calls) / below prior-day RTH low (puts)
feature_definitions.newx5: 1 if m>=5 and max(H[m-4..m]) is the day extreme so far (>= max H[0..m]) and > max H[0..m-5]; H=high for calls, -low for puts
feature_definitions.vwap_side: 1 if s*close[m] > s*VWAP[m]; VWAP = cumsum(typical*vol)/cumsum(vol), typical=(h+l+c)/3, from 09:30
feature_definitions.eff10: k=min(10,m); seg=X[m-k..m]; max(seg[-1]-seg[0],0)/sum|diff(seg)|; 0 if no path
feature_definitions.spread_c: clip((ask-bid)/ask,0,1) at minute m+2 of the chosen contract; NaN->1
feature_definitions.l_ovol5: log1p(sum option volume minutes m-4..m), NaN->0

missing_values.order: 1) l_rvol/l_ovol5/l_ask NaN->0, spread_c NaN->1, pe5 NaN->0; 2) any remaining NaN in a model feature -> the replay median below (computed on all 142-day cards before fill)

contract_selection: Handoff: nearest strike strictly OTM of stock close[m] for the side (1 strike OTM), with finite ask>0 at m+2; 0DTE if any listed for that side else 1DTE.

stock_strength.rank: rank(v)=count(ref < v)/n_ref (numpy searchsorted left on the sorted fit reference). Use the exact sorted arrays below for parity; the 101-quantile tables are for convenience (linear interpolation, approx).
stock_strength.missing: rvol NaN->0 before ranking; pm_brk/pd_brk/newx5 NaN->0; mo_atr NaN->replay median 0.538022

cutoffs.rounded: 0.802 / 0.876 (apply: >=q90 -> top10 floor, elif >=q80 -> top20 floor, else A bar)

floors.note: post handoff card if p_win >= floor (equivalently hoF >= v2eq_bar)

hybrid_lane.bars: v2_score tiers: 0DTE B>=40, A>=58; 1DTE B>=61, A>=80; post A and B
hybrid_lane.note: v2 scores come from Nia newmodel scored_v2 (387-feature model), not part of this spec

dedupe: same contract within 5 minutes (T=m+2) keeps first
